title: LinkDeliveryV1
description: One durable delivery: the envelope plus the delivery metadata a receipt references (the receipt refers to the durable deliveryId, not the socket). Identical shape on the SignalR Deliver client method and the HTTP GET /deliveries items. The envelope $ref resolves by $id (same style as envelope-command.json); idToken/rfc3339DateTime constraints are inlined verbatim from common.v1.json#$defs because this file lives beside envelope.json in cloudevents-schemas/ and the OpenAPI validator resolves refs physically.
